title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Greek Theatre, Los Angeles | 2024
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Greek Theatre in Los Angeles, California, USA, on 8 September 2024.

It was the 14th show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s 2024 tour.

View this post on Instagram

Starr had previously performed at the Greek Theatre on 3 and 4 September 1989, 11 and 12 August 1992, 18 and 19 August 1995, 2 August 2008, 7 August 2010, 21 July 2012, 19 July 2014, 2 July 2016, 29 September 2018, 1 September 2019, and 15 June 2023. He returned there on 14 June 2026.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
